title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-19
lineage: CD -> EAC(secure, offset corrected) -> CoolEdit Pro -> TLH -> FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a legendary Fillmore East set highlighted by an epic Dark Star and a fiery Not Fade Away/China Cat jam.
ai_review.review: The Reynolds SBD delivers a remarkably clean mix that lets the 1970 Dead’s improvisational brilliance shine.  Reviewers rave about a soaring Dark Star, a standout Not Fade Away with a rare China Cat interlude, and a punchy St. Stephen, while noting only minor pitch‑correction quirks in some tracks.  Overall the performance is described as one of the band’s most exhilarating nights.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews overwhelmingly praise both the musical performance and the recording quality; minor technical quirks are noted but do not detract from the show’s greatness, resulting in a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Most reviewers call the mix crisp, clean and well‑balanced; a few point out occasional speed/pitch anomalies and drop‑outs in fragmentary audience recordings, but the core SBD is considered listenable and faithful to the original performance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised for its seamless flow from the opening Dark Star into a soaring Not Fade Away with an unexpected China Cat tease, followed by a tight St. Stephen and a playful Lovelight, culminating in Pigpen’s final Good Morning School Girl before the band bows out.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly lauded for his tone, improvisational daring on Dark Star and overall top‑form playing.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned as carrying much of the momentum on the later Dark Star; also noted for explaining the early end to the show because of a cramping hand.
band_member_comments.Bob: Praised for rhythmic jams (especially during Not Fade Away/China Cat) and for his vocal energy.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey’s “cannon” fills are highlighted as adding excitement, particularly in St. Stephen and the Dark Star climax.
